operations.title: The clinic receiving route
operations.objective: Keep a civilian clinic supplied while both commands inspect its transport.

operations.title: A limited occupation mandate
operations.objective: Issue enforceable civilian access instructions to the garrison.

operations.title: Eyes over the retreat
operations.objective: Rebuild reconnaissance coverage with aircraft actually deployed.

operations.title: Receive the allied headquarters
operations.objective: Prepare a receiving base; accepting the headquarters needs present consent.

operations.title: A funded transport reserve
operations.objective: Deliver a defined transport commitment without assuming coalition consent.

operations.title: A second receiving site
operations.objective: Open distributed reception and accept its continuing administrative burden.

operations.title: Inspect the command docket
operations.objective: Verify the coalition order trail and preserve the unresolved cases.

operations.title: The harbor offensive
operations.objective: Prepare maritime targeting and support the conventional naval campaign.

operations.title: The sky over Comona
operations.objective: Commit a prepared air force to the air campaign.

operations.title: A continental bridgehead
operations.objective: Establish an actual mainland foothold before claiming a continental landing.

operations.title: Bring the engineers through
operations.objective: Protect the engineers and families whose information makes an attack possible.

operations.title: Silence the battery
operations.objective: Exploit the engineering intelligence and commit the prepared strike.

operations.title: Keep the reserve aircraft grounded
operations.objective: Accept reduced immediate readiness to complete safety repairs.

operations.title: A withdrawal with its people
operations.objective: Authorize withdrawal rather than consuming the surviving cadre in a last stand.

operations.title: The city after the front
operations.objective: Return to the clinic and resolve the occupation records after actual liberation.

operations.title: The final launch complex
operations.objective: Prepare the final assault after the military surrender.

operations.title: The orders we signed
operations.objective: Hear the occupation cases under the settlement that actually occurred.

operations.title: Keep the original messages
operations.objective: Preserve reciprocal messages and their authors instead of assuming consent.

operations.title: The officer who asks again
operations.objective: Verify disputed orders and protect the right to ask for confirmation.

operations.title: Defend the receiving island
operations.objective: Prepare aircraft, dispersal and warning coverage before the first carrier strike.

operations.title: The first submarine hunt
operations.objective: Use current air capability and the island defense records to attack the carrier.

operations.title: The submerged perimeter
operations.objective: Coordinate maritime denial and give the submarine crews a credible withdrawal plan.

operations.title: Recall the second carrier
operations.objective: Preserve the second strategic carrier at the cost of withdrawing its threat.

operations.title: Support the Bastok landing
operations.objective: Support an observed foothold; orders cannot create possession of the peninsula.

operations.title: The Razgriz Straits strike
operations.condition: check_variable = { deployed_airforce_manpower_k > 0 } check_variable = { num_deployed_planes > 0 } NOT = { has_global_flag = ac_camp_naval_reserve_success }
operations.objective: Attack the second carrier before a completed recall removes its operational threat.

operations.title: The homeland receiving line
operations.objective: Receive civilians from the actual invasion front without inventing provincial transfers.

operations.title: A rescue plan before the ceremony
operations.objective: Reserve rescue coverage and a recovery crew before the ceremony attack.

operations.title: The order that does not match
operations.objective: Protect contradictory orders and pursue the compromised command channel.

operations.title: The flight outside the command
operations.objective: Protect the squadron departure after the investigation breaks with compromised command.

operations.title: The independent liaison
operations.objective: Protect the independent contact needed to locate the imprisoned political authority.

operations.title: Bring the president back
operations.objective: Use the protected evidence to mount the political rescue.

operations.title: An authority the army cannot erase
operations.objective: Restore the political voice needed for a reciprocal peace effort.

operations.title: A mixed force that can receive orders
operations.objective: Coordinate the final joint effort with a present Yuktobanian command.

operations.title: Intercept the captured platform
operations.condition: check_variable = { deployed_airforce_manpower_k > 0 } check_variable = { num_deployed_planes > 0 } has_global_flag = ac_cpw_arkbird_committed
operations.objective: Intercept only a platform that was actually committed to the war.

operations.title: The last interception
operations.objective: Complete the interception before asking either government to call the crisis resolved.

operations.title: Open the settlement files
operations.objective: Read the actual earlier settlement before deciding what Belka owes its veterans.

operations.title: Protect the independent investigation
operations.objective: Protect witnesses and a trail of procurement influence from political interference.

operations.title: Build the covert channel
operations.objective: Spend national capacity on a covert channel that can also be discovered.

operations.title: Influence the procurement chain
operations.objective: Extend the network while accepting a permanent trail of exposure.

operations.title: Bring the witness into daylight
operations.objective: Deliver evidence that gives the foreign investigations an independent corroboration.

operations.title: Contest the orbital command channel
operations.objective: Attempt strategic access while Osean and Yuktobanian investigators close in.

operations.title: The state answers for its secrets
operations.objective: Record exposure, defeat or an alternate network success without declaring a national war.

operations.title: Protect the civil files
operations.objective: Protect residents from collective suspicion while investigating specific conduct.

operations.title: A mandate for access
operations.objective: Offer limited access under the current mandate; Osea must answer.

operations.title: The limited sovereign mission
operations.objective: Offer bounded assistance while preserving an independent decision to withdraw.

operations.title: The inspected transit route
operations.objective: Offer a transit arrangement with inspection and a present receiving permission.

operations.title: The affordable contribution
operations.objective: Offer a limited contribution whose domestic opportunity cost remains visible.

operations.title: The council receives the offer
operations.objective: Open consultation without silently granting access, guarantees or faction membership.

The families on the technical brief
A sky that must be used
The aircraft left in the hangar
The pencil at the receiving table
The last plot on the screen
The witness who needed a door
The names left off the return
The person who could answer back
The line in the final account
The favors that became a record
The last flight in the file
The last place on the board
People who still knew the aircraft
A pilot at the kitchen table
An empty chair at the table
